text: Today is Pournami, the full moon day.
It is a time when nothing is hidden — the sky holds nothing back, inviting us to open our hearts with gratitude rather than asking for more.
This evening, you are invited to light a deepam at your tulasi kota or in your mandir.
You may offer a prayer with the Lalitha Sahasranamam, or any Devi stotram that resonates with you.
If it is convenient, white flowers and payasam can be offered.
For families who observe it, the Sri Satyanarayana Vratam is traditionally performed on this auspicious day.
Take a moment to reflect on this past month and name one thing that went well for you, saying it aloud with a thankful heart.
